Wider setting — Vaelmark: The city of magic and arcane technology — the arcane capital, a city older than the kingdom, powered by a pre-Sundering mana-channel grid that Velkan Drake restored and extended in Year 1033. Home of the Veilborn Arcanum, the largest magic academy in the known world, the Royal Athenaeum, the Arcane Artillery Corps and the Ninth Sky Corps base.

Vaelmark is a DRAKE CITY — home base of the Ninth Sky Corps and its 180 Sky Drakes: wherever sky shows (or through a window), a patrol pair of ridden drakes crosses it or a drake rests on a tower ledge; a drake rider or two in flight leathers walks among the crowd. Drakes are WYVERNS, NOT DRAGONS — exactly two legs, the wings are the front limbs, no fire, about the size of a big horse; never four-legged, never like a winged horse.
Architecture: Starhaven's established look, matching the other images of the kingdom — a dark, grand high-fantasy stone city: weathered grey and charcoal stone, soaring towers and slender spires, pointed and round arches, grand domed halls, clock towers, steep dark slate roofs, wrought-iron lanterns, heavy carved detail, mist between the buildings and mountains on the horizon. Subtle accents from the kingdom's many peoples appear only in details, never taking over: some carved stone balconies and scalloped arches, a few blue-tiled domes, the odd gently upturned roof edge on a market hall, dwarven geometric reliefs and bronze fittings, elven curved woodwork and climbing ivy. It must NOT look Indian, Chinese, Japanese or Persian overall — it is one consistent dark fantasy kingdom. Vaelmark signature: a dark gothic city of countless needle spires, with glowing blue rune-channels running through the masonry and canals of blue arcane light; drakes may circle high above.
Lighting and time of day: evening, canal lights and the blue glow of the sweets.

Never in rows, never uniform cloaks, never all facing the camera. Clothing true to the medieval era — wool, linen, leather and fur; tunics, hoods, cloaks, aprons and boots — never modern dress.
Who lives here (Compendium → Peoples → Who lives where, “Vaelmark”): mostly Humans; Drakari and half-Drakari are about a third of the city (their ancient home); also Half-elves, moon and high elves, goblin artificers, dwarves; a few Astralborn. About a third of the crowd should be Drakari or half-Drakari. Drakari look: tall and lean, amber-gold slit-pupil eyes, faint bronze dragon-scale patterning at the temples, jaw and neck. Mages, scholars, students and artificers in varied colours (not all robes); drake riders of the Ninth Sky Corps in flight leathers. Still a mixed kingdom — several races clearly visible.

Proposals made after midnight are considered binding; so are insults, which is why there are two healers on duty.

The first copy off the press each night goes, by tradition, to the night-cart crews and the rakers, who are the first people awake in the city.
